verdict.rationale: Alloy publicly serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at a stable docs URL (alloy.yaml), so the machine-readable spec can be downloaded directly. Per-page .md mirrors also carry per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments. The spec file is not linked from the docs UI because the download button is disabled, which weakens discoverability but does not block retrieval. Missing for 10: a UI-linked or advertised spec download, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the full spec is fetched and usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin (servers sandbox.alloy.co/v1 and api.alloy.co/v1)
